## Proposed change

Identify the section or XML anchor and link the relevant issue, if any.

## Reason and evidence boundary

Explain which claim or inference the change clarifies and why it is supported.

## Checks performed

Run `make review`, `make check`, `make test`, and `make build` when the
formatter is installed. Include the regenerated reading copy. Record any
check that could not be run; do not edit an existing published snapshot.

List the checks run and their results. For a rendering, give the formatter
version and command; note checks that could not be completed.
Keep every published snapshot unchanged.

Contribution terms, attribution, and privacy guidance are in CONTRIBUTING.md.
